name: Anacua
caution: Mild and sweet, eaten fresh in small amounts. Never eat a wild plant on this guide's word alone. Confirm identity against several sources and learn the look-alikes first.

sections.title: Identification
sections.body: The 'sandpaper tree,' named for its rough leaves, drops fragrant white flower clusters and then sweet orange fruit that birds adore.

sections.title: On the trail
sections.body: A pleasant fresh nibble rather than a kitchen crop; the fruit is small and mostly seed.
